top.en: Let me say something controversial. This year, the LPL has been mocking Valorant for having four teams finish in the top 16, but many haven't realized that almost all of our international results in recent years were carried by BLG. Yet, BLG gets flamed daily in China, especially Bin, who gets the worst of it. He used to be able to handle it, but after MSI, he couldn't take it anymore and changed his playstyle, or rather, his mentality just shattered. And honestly, calling him the 'war criminal' at MSI except for the K'Sante game in game 4 makes no sense. The bot lane and jungler were not clean at all. BLG is essentially carried by their mid and top. You could see that against WE; without them, they wouldn't even have made MSI, let alone get the LPL runner-up spot to earn a 4th seed. Now, I feel like Bin doesn't even know how to play his old style in the top lane anymore. If Knight can't step up, they'll be lucky to reach the quarterfinals. The most disgusting thing about the LPL is that people know which team will actually get results, yet they flame them every day. If you show any confidence and make a mistake, you get cyberbullied. And the player you're bullying is the core of the team. The funniest part is that people still use this team's recent results—the last bit of LPL's face—to mock other games. Casters and viewers are all the same. When [~N:0:Master] came this year, a caster boldly claimed BLG was invincible, but now, if it were Master, they wouldn't even be able to fight back. In short, looking at this year, the LPL's chances of winning Worlds are slim, but the viewers and some casters don't seem to care. They just want to bully people online and feel good about themselves. Results don't matter. When the time comes, they'll just use past results to mock other games again, which I find quite 'delightful'.
